SELECT r.smit_year, r.smit_no, r.biz_tp_cd, r.biz_frm_cd, r.form_ty_cd, f.* FROM report_submission r
JOIN form_sample_offr f ON f.submission_id = r.id
JOIN form_symposium_offr f ON f.submission_id = r.id
JOIN form_clinical_trial f ON f.submission_id = r.id
JOIN form_product_pst f ON f.submission_id = r.id
JOIN form_post_market_invt f ON f.submission_id = r.id
JOIN form_expense_dc f ON f.submission_id = r.id
JOIN form_performance_cfr f ON f.submission_id = r.id
JOIN form_sample_offr f ON f.submission_id = r.id
WHERE r.form_ty_cd = #{formTyCd} ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT menu_id, menu_path, menu_title, menu_group, menu_section, depth, app_uri, login_required FROM menu ORDER BY menu_id
SELECT slug, uri, menu_id, expected_status FROM uri_baseline ORDER BY menu_id, slug
SELECT code_group, code, code_name, sort_order FROM common_code WHERE code_group = #{codeGroup} ORDER BY sort_order
